name: Requirements governance modes preserve immutable history
summary: Newly provisioned projects start in simple mode. Existing projects without governance history remain governed. A signed-in project owner may switch modes with revision and hash compare-and-swap; switching never accepts content or rewrites earlier history. The endpoint checks current owner membership. Backup and restore carry governance history, owner operation receipts and validated source bindings. A present JSON-null or damaged history refuses with a repair message; absence alone keeps the legacy governed behavior. Host operator requirement authority remains unchanged. Governance reads attach a bounded entry-specific clock warning past the existing skew bound. Future timestamps do not refuse reads or writes, rewrite history or order authority; revision numbers and hashes retain that role.
